welcome.headline: Find free parking. Understand the rules. Park with confidence.

welcome.v2b: Compare options near your destination before you drive.

location.title: Find parking around you
location.body: Zpot uses your location to show parking nearby and walking times. Searching a destination works without it.
location.use: Only while you use the app.
location.use2: We never sell your location. You can change this any time.

precise.title: You’re all set
precise.body: Zpot will show parking around you. You can also search any destination.

approx.title: Results near you may be less accurate
approx.body: Zpot only knows your rough area. Search your exact destination for the best results, or allow precise location in Settings.

denied.title: No problem — search a destination
denied.body: You can find parking anywhere in Lisbon by typing an address or place. Turn on location any time in Settings.

restricted.title: Location is restricted on this device
restricted.body: A device policy blocks location. Search a destination instead.

off.title: Location services are turned off
off.body: Turn them on in your device settings to see parking near you — or search a destination now.

unavailable.title: We couldn’t get your location right now
unavailable.body: This happens indoors or underground. We’ll try again later; you can search a destination meanwhile.

notifIntro.title: Reminders when they matter
notifIntro.body: Zpot can remind you before your parking time ends or a restriction starts. We only ask for notification permission when you start a parking session — never at launch.

account.title: Save places and track your reports
account.body: An account syncs saved places and lets you follow your reports. Finding parking never needs one.

help.title: Help
help.a1: We combine official parking rules (where available) with checks by drivers and scouts, then work out what applies for your arrival time and stay. In this development build all rules are sample data.
help.a2: No payment is required for your selected time and no restriction applies, according to the rules we have. It doesn’t mean a space is empty — availability is not confirmed.
help.a3: Verified: matched to an official source on the date shown. Community-confirmed: confirmed by drivers with photos. Rules unconfirmed: we don’t know — check the signs.
help.q4: Why does Zpot want my location?
help.a4: To show nearby parking and walking times. You can search a destination instead and change permission any time in your device settings.
help.a5: No. You can search, compare and navigate as a guest. An account syncs saved places and lets you follow your reports.
